ideas.pitch: A lightweight multilingual AI health assistant tailored for semi-urban and rural public health awareness.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets local community needs with a proven winning pattern of social impact and multilingual accessibility, scoring high on problem-solution and presentation criteria.
